meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION + CALCULATION (Rev H active-nose pen with inertial options; model H1; nothing measured)

inertial_module.as: not included in Rev H by the rule below; kept as an evaluated option (CAD variant, optional components in layout.json)
inertial_module.module: Rear-cap reaction mass: WHA 19.8 g (d 10 x 14.0 mm), +/-2.8 mm, 2 axes, Km 0.9 N/sqrt(W)

power_W.note: copper loss max over all test conditions + 0.012 W driver/Hall (ASSUMPTION)

criteria.rule:
as used here (set after the grid, not pre-declared): >= 10 % further reduction of the ink error in the
    8-12 Hz, 1-2 mm band on every test seed at r_rot 0.5 and 0.7, and no split where it is worse on average.

inertial_module.label: SIM + CALC

choice.why: B (skid ring on the fixed front sleeve carries the writing force; the refill carrier tilts on a flexure gimbal) beats A on every simulated criterion: perfect-knowledge ceiling 0.09-0.24 vs 0.15-0.77, coil power ~0.002 W vs 0.31-1.0 W (with a bias spring), no writing-force modulation (A: 0.3-0.7 N rms), and the tilt-plane correction needs no pressing of the tip into the paper.

power_battery.label: CALC on SIM forces; base electronics 0.065 W ASSUMPTION
